title: Eight-sided Great Pyramid and the Templar flag

tellings.quote:
The Templar flag is an eight-sided
pyramid turned into a 2D shape. So, if
you take the Templar flag and you create
into a threedimensional object, you get
the great pyramid of Giza.

plain: The flag of the Knights Templar, the medieval crusading order, is said to be the Great Pyramid of Giza drawn flat: an eight-sided pyramid laid out in two dimensions. Jay Anderson makes this case to Michels, saying that "if you take the Templar flag and you create it into a three-dimensional object, you get the great pyramid of Giza," and he draws on the video commentator Dark Journalist and the writer Joseph P. Farrell. If so, the order's symbol would carry hidden knowledge of the pyramid's true shape.
